snippet.title: Elta: Defy All Gods - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Release early 2027 - Wishlist now on PC, XBOX Series X|S & PS5: https://urls.fr/KI4F4D

Rise as a divine champion in Elta: Defy All Gods, our new amped-up action-platformer!

Watch the trailer revealed during the Opening Night Live!

💥 Master explosive melee combat
🧭 Chain traversal moves through winding worlds
🐲 Team-up with your dragon-god companion

Get ready to bring down the gods!
